hints.text: Move with {moveF}{moveL}{moveB}{moveR}. Hold {dash} to sprint. {jump} to jump.
{light} light attack (chain up to 4 hits as Kael, 3 as Giva). {heavy} heavy attack. Tap {bolt} to fire an Aether Bolt, or hold it to aim. {ability} uses your ability.
Powerups activate on pickup. Stored powerups can be used from the inventory ({inventory}) or with keys 1-5.
Press {swap} to switch between Kael and Giva. Each has different abilities.
Phase Dash and Phase Step are online. Tap {dash} to phase. You're invulnerable for a moment while you do.
Echo Sight unlocked. As Giva, press {ability} to reveal hidden doors, caches and recordings.
Ultimate abilities unlocked. When the ring is full, press {ultimate}.
Press {lockon} to lock onto the nearest enemy.
Save terminals let you save manually. The game also autosaves at checkpoints.
Spend Aether Fragments in the Ability Matrix ({skills}).
{throttle} to accelerate, {brake} to brake and reverse, {steerLeft}{steerRight} to steer. Hold {handbrake} to drift. {vehicleReset} puts the car back on its wheels, {interact} gets you out.
